database.money_unit: raw ledger integer: 10 = 1 XA coin; 100 = 1 RMB

backend.scope: Settled full refund recovery, aftersale reopening, audit reversals, benefits, realtime invalidations, and concurrent money operations

isolation.mysql: disposable MySQL 8 container xa-refund-mysql-20261020 with network none, no published ports; app shares only its isolated network namespace
isolation.mysql_schema: complete real migration chain applied to the isolated test database

verified_financial_invariants: Refunds recover actual successful original INCOME, GIFT, and SHOP_INCOME credits, including multiple providers and inviter shares.
Only this order's unreleased IncomeHold can fund recovery. Foreign income holds and pending withdrawal frozen funds remain untouched.
Ambiguous historical deposit ownership falls back to available balance and never reduces another order's current deposit.
Platform commission recovery protects unrelated deposit funds.
Any recipient shortfall aborts the entire transaction with no refund, reversal, order, point, benefit, or notification mutation.
Plan confirmation rechecks current wallet and source ledger facts; changed amount, missing original credit, stale tokens, and unauthorized settled refunds are rejected.
Original ledger and approval snapshots remain; reversals link one-to-one to originals and preserve balance_before + amount = balance_after.
Cancelled income holds do not release later; net order income includes negative reversal INCOME entries.
Confirmed consumption is reversed in place, point allocations and refundable coupons are restored, current-cycle VIP and unused rights are recalculated, and consumed benefits remain auditable.
Resolved settled aftersales can reopen with request idempotency and history preservation.
Order and wallet invalidations are emitted only after commit, with role-filtered refund summaries and no cross-owner balance leakage.
Legacy gift refunds reverse actual positive gift credits, cancel unfulfilled source-order gift rights, and rebuild only the affected naming extension.
limits: The SQLite and MySQL suites overlap; their counts are separate executions and must not be added as unique tests.
This report covers isolated backend regressions. Live fixture money and UI verification are recorded separately by the coordinating agent.

Cross-wallet order settlement, refund and gift transactions intentionally share a short database mutex to avoid customer/inviter lock cycles; single-wallet withdrawals and income release do not take it.
Already consumed coupons and completed physical deliveries are recorded rather than converted to automatic customer debt.

sqlite_broad_regression.skip_reason: SQLite lacks select_for_update. All four skipped cases passed in the final real MySQL run.
sqlite_broad_regression.source_phase: Before the final cumulative-gift qualification and claim/account lock-order follow-up.

concurrency_cases: same-order simultaneous refunds reverse each original credit once
refund versus income release cannot release a cancelled hold or double-credit
refund versus withdrawal cannot spend pending withdrawal frozen funds
refund versus settlement cannot leave income on a refunded order
cross-order customer/inviter wallet cycle with shared provider completes without deadlock
100 percent commission zero-income provider refund versus cash deposit return completes without inverted locks
source-order refund versus gift checkout uses consistent order-first locks
two existing report settlement concurrency cases
two existing fund receipt concurrency cases
two existing gift basket concurrency cases
mysql_broad_regression.source_phase: Before the final cumulative-gift qualification and claim/account lock-order follow-up.

changes: Recheck cumulative gift qualification in the original activity/source-order window after excluding the refunded payment; cancel undelivered affected claims while preserving completed delivery audit.
Lock and cache affected VIP/GIFT claims before ClubAccount and MemberTag updates; exclude REDEMPTION to prevent claim/account foreign-key lock cycles.

mysql.new_concurrency_case: VIP TAG delivery holds its claim before refund attempts the claim lock, then performs a real MemberTag INSERT/account FK check; both transactions commit without deadlock and the completed tag is correctly audited/revoked.

final_benefit_followup.independent_read_only_review: PASS: no remaining mandatory issue in final implementation.

final_benefit_followup.schema_changes: None after the broad migration consistency check.
